scope: two ideal ng=0 transmons; no EM, noise or measured-device claim
rationale: 1 Hz absolute numerical resolution for all six excitation energies and last refinement, chosen before these cases run; not experimental uncertainty. Scaled residual 1e-12 bounds algebraic solve quality separately from truncation. Mathieu periodic spectrum is restricted to ng=0 and shares SciPy with the solver; it is a different algorithm, not an independent library or measurement.
